title: Sorting gloves at the reuse center
passage: Thanks for helping at the reuse center. We’ll send sealed bags of paired work gloves to the training workshop this afternoon. If a bag is damp, leave it open on the drying rack first. For the loose gloves, check the worksheet on the table. Make pairs only within the same bin. You need one left glove and one right glove for each new pair. Don’t break up pairs that are already complete; those are packed separately. Start at the bin where you can make the most new pairs. When you finish, put any loose gloves you couldn’t match back in their bin.
passageZh: 謝謝大家到再利用中心幫忙。今天下午會把封裝好、成對的工作手套送到訓練工坊。如果袋子潮濕，先打開放到晾乾架。散裝手套請依桌上的工作表。只能在同一箱內配對。每配一副需要一隻左手套和一隻右手套。不要拆開已配好的一副，這些另行包裝。從能新增最多副的箱子開始。完成後，無法配對的散裝手套要放回各自原箱。
